title: Fudoh
wikitext:
Quakeworld clan formed in the first quarter of 2002 with the purpose of playing competitive 4on4, and having fun while doing it. Most in Fudoh had played Quake since it was released, but new players also joined the ranks. Members from Fudoh later formed [[Hixos]].
